mapper.select: SELECT ur.user_id, r.id AS role_id, r.code, r.name FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id IN #{id} ORDER BY ur.user_id, r.code

SELECT p.code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.enabled = 1 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.code = rp.permission_code AND p.enabled = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.id <> 'system-admin'
